source:
## Email addresses, the pragmatic subset: dot-separated atoms locally,
## dotted labels with a 2-6 letter TLD in the domain. Label edge
## hyphens are tolerated here (real registries reject them; the demo
## keeps the shape simple).
grammar Email version "1.0.0" {
  alpha = %x41-5A / %x61-7A
  digit = %x30-39
  ## atext without the dot (dots separate atoms).
  lchar = alpha / digit / %x21 / %x23-27 / %x2A / %x2B / %x2D / %x3D / %x3F / %x5E-7E
  local = 1*lchar *( "." 1*lchar )
  ## Pragmatic domain: at least two dotted labels; the TLD's 2-6
  ## letter shape is not enforced (a registry concern, not a syntax one).
  label = 1*( alpha / digit / %x2D )
  domain = label 1*( "." label )
  address = local "@" domain as host

  entry main: address

  test {
    accept "person@example.com"
    accept "first.last+tag@sub.example.org"
    accept "a_b-c@d-1.io"
    reject "no-at-sign.com"
    reject "@empty-local.com"
    reject "person@host."
  }
}
